name: capability-rows
description: Capability rows: tinted, outlined rows with an icon and title on the left and a description and explore link on the right, plus an optional closing line with a button. Live: #ap-gov-solution on the industry hubs.

title_accent.description: Part of the heading painted with the brand gradient.

items.description: Rows. Each: title (required), body, link_label, url, tone (indigo, green, yellow, blue, red, cyan); icon (URL) or icon_svg.

ender_accent.description: Part of the closing heading painted with the gradient.
